title: Solving the Ho--Nguyen Conjecture for Gaussian Mixtures: Applications to Mixtures of Experts
abstract: arXiv:2610.27265v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Over-fitted Gaussian mixtures can contain many parameter configurations with nearly the same density, making the order of density cancellation central to their parameter-learning rates. Ho and Nguyen encoded these cancellations in a polynomial system and conjectured its exact order as a function of cluster size. The key to resolving the conjecture is a common positive-variance shift that turns the coefficient equations into Gaussian moment matching. For every cluster size $\Mhn\ge2$, we prove that the real, nonzero-weight system has order $2\Mhn$: a sharp sign-change bound forces rigidity at that order, while positive Gauss--Hermite quadrature constructs a non-trivial solution through order $2\Mhn-1$. translated_title: 解决高斯混合模型中的Ho--Nguyen猜想：在专家混合模型中的应用
translated_abstract: 过拟合的高斯混合模型可能包含许多密度几乎相同的参数配置，这使得密度抵消的阶数成为其参数学习速率的核心问题。Ho和Nguyen将这些抵消编码为一个多项式系统，并猜想其精确阶数是聚类大小的函数。解决该猜想的关键是一种共同的正方差平移，它将系数方程转化为高斯矩匹配问题。对于每个聚类大小 $\Mhn\ge2$，我们证明了实数、非零权重系统的阶数恰为 $2\Mhn$：一个锐利的符号变化界在该阶数处强制刚性，而正Gauss--Hermite求积则构造出直至 $2\Mhn-1$ 阶的非平凡解。以110位有效数字精度进行的总体密度计算恢复了两到六个分量情形下预测的首项；有限多重启动搜索在两到五个分量的情形下恢复出相同的观测幂次，较小的有限规模……
tldr: 本文解决了Ho--Nguyen猜想，证明对所有聚类大小M≥2的高斯混合，实数非零权重系统的密度抵消阶数恰为2M，为过拟合高斯混合模型和专家混合模型的参数学习速率提供了严格的理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper resolves the Ho--Nguyen conjecture by proving that for every cluster size M≥2, the real nonzero-weight system of Gaussian mixtures has exact order 2M, establishing sharp theoretical guarantees for parameter learning rates in over-fitted mixtures and mixtures of experts.
